g.text: Backend binds only to Windows loopback; HTTPS listener disabled.
GEMINI_API_KEY exists only in the Java environment.
Public health checks omit Basic credentials.
Phone loopback is not Windows loopback without ADB reverse.
USB routes and real translation are user-confirmed.
Custom native debug APK and release deployment are NOT verified.
Expo Go uses its own native network-security policy.
Local university development architecture, not a production network deployment.
No client calls Gemini directly. No public/LAN HTTP endpoint is exposed by Java.
Remote production use requires HTTPS and a separately reviewed access model.
